## 3. Verified source record

The complete JSON entry below is copied from the current local source. Preserve its id, author_id, author_name, day, hour, knowledge_key, timestamp, and exact text. Candidate prose is editorial material, not part of the loaded row.

{
  "id": "journal_raw_b3_12_botanist_the_third_seedling",
  "text": "The wheat named for Tomas has set seed. Four heads. I cut them today with the small scissors the Watchmaker lent me and I held them in my hand and I counted the grains. Thirty-one grains. Thirty-one grains from one seed is not a harvest. It is a proof. It is proof that wheat will grow here and will seed here and that the seed will be true. I will plant all thirty-one. If even half take, I will have one hundred and fifty grains next cycle, and after that, enough to try a small outdoor plot when the Meteorologist says the surface dose has dropped. She says maybe by Day 200. Maybe. I put the four seed heads in the envelope with the letter to Tomas. I did not seal it. I want him to see them. I know he cannot see them. I put them in the envelope anyway. The third seedling from the left was always the strongest. I told Galina. She said she would make sure no one moved the envelope. She did not ask why I was crying. She is good at not asking why.",

Do not claim a harvest or state who Tomas is beyond the entry.
